notes.title: Devlog #13: AGRONOM in Motion — New YouTube Series & Playtest Prep
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martian Farmers! 🌱🚀[/h1][p]
What a month! We released our very first Gameplay Trailer for [b]AGRONOM[/b]—and we’re thrilled to finally show the game in motion. If you haven’t watched it yet, now’s the perfect time:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/-HWB6JXZfhk"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]New on Our YouTube Channel[/h2][p][/p][h3]Automate Your Farm — Episode 1[/h3][p]We’ve launched a new series, [b]Automate Your Farm[/b], where we demonstrate how robot helpers streamline your Martian routine in [b]AGRONOM[/b]. Episode 1 is a top-down timelapse: watch your robots hustle like tiny ants—from the drill to the Universal Compartment, to the Greenhouse, and then to the Cargo Station—shipping resources to fulfill corporate orders. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/twL9vvm9pkA"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]AGRONOVA Product Spotlight — 3 new episodes[/h3][p]We also kicked off the [b]AGRONOVA Product Spotlight[/b] series with three videos, including looks at the Robot Gardener, Robot Worker, and Robot Assistant. This is a series of videos produced by AgroNova Corporation. The world of AGRONOM is full of robots. And AgroNova Corporation is the one that supplies the production plans for most of the helper robots in the solar system. Watch their commercials for the AGR series of helper robots on our Youtube Channel. And don't forget to subscribe—new videos once a week or more often![/p][p]
[/p][h1]Visuals[/h1][p][/p][h3]Five Robots, Five Personalities[/h3][p]All five robot helpers now have unique colors and extra detail, making them easier to tell apart at a glance—and those colors reflect their roles and personalities. Want a closer look at the Worker and Assistant? Check out the Product Spotlight episodes bellow! [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/PWL1SKmCfJ4"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/gJPVvPFuTBU"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Glass Blocks, Eastern Vibes[/h3][p]Glass blocks are a signature of our Eastern European mood—architectural nostalgia meets off-world pragmatism. We treated them with extra care to nail the texture, light, and vibe. How do you like them, Martians? [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/d7b5e2d921fe116a13f25bbecea0f1671dc96242.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/2c489f6ba6c864e333619ad0f0b1f6b703c56ef0.png"][/img][/p][h3]Solid Foundations[/h3][p]Outdoor buildings now get proper foundations. Steep Martian terrain used to leave some structures “floating”—no more. Things should sit just right from here on out. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/c18233f44ba3f46c91273a1cc71678fe21591e75.png"][/img][/p][h3]Plant Overhaul: Experiments in Progress[/h3][p]We’ve begun a major pass on plants. The versions you saw in the trailer and playtests were among our earliest models—now we’re experimenting with look and feel. Here’s a peek at cucumbers and an apple tree. More natural, more cozy, more AGRONOM.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/d456f7a76941a81a67303102d0b3b69a9f2be5d9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/7c17c4f715281ace5dca90927ec049e7930ef5b9.png"][/img][/p][h3]A New Jump Animation[/h3][p]We made a jump! …and we’re keeping it under wraps for now. Soon™. [/p][p][/p][h1]Gameplay[/h1][p][/p][h3]Playtest Build Work Continues[/h3][p]We’ve added new quests, tuned tasks, and wrote fresh lines for characters. The tutorial is now woven into quests and dialogue—teaching through play and cutting walls of text. [/p][p][/p][h3]Greenhouse & Environment Controls[/h3][p]You’ll find dedicated UI screens for the Environment Controller and status cards above each greenhouse niche, so it’s easy to see what’s growing and how it’s doing—at a glance. [/p][p][/p][h3]World & Polish[/h3][p]We’ve integrated a wave of art updates, fully switched to a 24-hour day type (actually, on Mars, it's a cycle of 24 hours, 39 minutes, and 35 seconds, hehe), and added a flashlight for night work. New quests have passed first internal tests; next up is full team testing. We also implemented proper quest turn-in logic in the journal, alongside many smaller fixes and niceties. [/p][p][/p][h1]What’s Next? 😏[/h1][p]Next month we plan to wrap up Playtest prep, begin integrating our first updated UI, and refresh the game’s music. We’ll analyze your playtest feedback and adjust our roadmap. On the feature side: automation UX improvements, new animations for the (green and lovable) Robot Gardener, finishing the plant overhaul (trees included!), and continued environment work—like adding window VFX to finalize the Greenhouse interior. [/p][p][/p][h1]Join the Journey[/h1][list][*][p][url="https://youtu.be/-HWB6JXZfhk"]Watch the Gameplay Trailer[/url] and subscribe on YouTube (set reminders for new episodes!).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Request access to Playtests[/b] on our Steam page so you’re ready on day one. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Wishlist AGRONOM[/b] to support the project and help more players discover the game.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]And[url="https://discord.gg/P9dzU3sw5W"] join our Discord server [/url]to chat with devs and other Martian farmers.[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893250/AGRONOM/"][/dynamiclink][b]With love,[/b][/p][p][b]The AGRONOM Team 🧡[/b][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #12: First Gameplay Trailer on Aug 25 & Playtests Soon
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Martian Farmers! 🌱🚀[/h2][p]
Summer’s still in full swing, but the [b]AGRONOM[/b] workshop hasn’t cooled down. We’ve been polishing [b]visuals[/b], tightening [b]core systems[/b], and—most exciting of all—getting ready to show you the [b]game in motion[/b].
[/p][h2]Big News[/h2][p][/p][h3]Our First Gameplay Trailer Premieres on Monday, August 25[/h3][p]It’s finally time! Hit [b]“Set Reminder”[/b] on the premiere page so you can be among the very first to watch: [url="https://youtu.be/-HWB6JXZfhk"]YouTube Premiere[/url]. Your [b]comments[/b], [b]likes[/b], and [b]subscribes[/b] help this trailer travel far—thank you for powering [b]AGRONOM’s[/b] launch with your [b]support[/b]! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/-HWB6JXZfhk"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]New Playtests: Date Revealed Alongside the Trailer[/h3][p]We know you’ve been waiting (so have we!). With the trailer, we’ll also announce the date for our next [b]Playtests[/b]. We’ve spent the summer making meaningful changes across [b]visuals[/b] and [b]mechanics[/b]. Make sure you’ve requested Playtest access on our [b]Steam page[/b]—so you’re ready the moment gates open. [/p][p][/p][h1]Visuals[/h1][h3][/h3][h3]Robot Gardener[/h3][p]You met the [b]Robot Gardener[/b] in concept. Now meet the finished model—a calm, [b]plant-loving[/b], very green companion that [b]sows[/b], [b]waters[/b], and [b]harvests[/b] with care. He’s here to make your [b]fields thrive[/b] (and look adorable doing it).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/5c85de7121683dc042cbcca7870cebb4d44acb05.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Airlock Compartment Interior[/h3][p]Our artist team went all-in here: [b]dense detail[/b], [b]crisp textures[/b], and a look that nails our setting. Step inside and you’ll feel the world—[b]utilitarian[/b], [b]lived-in[/b], unmistakably [b]AGRONOM[/b]. Feel the [b]Eastern European vibe[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/77f77815d663811d2bcbbd68a52682e9cc6b203f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/e9054cc548dd7ccd5739dad7a87bf9ae3358471b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Cargo Station — Model Overhaul[/h3][p]During development, our idea of the [b]Cargo Platform[/b] evolved into the [b]Cargo Station[/b]—now, functionally, even a [b]Terminal[/b]. With systems for [b]city logistics[/b], [b]NPC trade[/b], the [b]in-game shop[/b], and [b]quest hooks[/b], we finally shaped a complete vision both in [b]mechanics[/b] and in [b]form[/b]. Look closely—the [b]details tell stories[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/1ec6f42f533fc843634dd2fba716e618ad64cbe6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/e3ce41d9e443ae55e05bdea64e7b1969fcf984c8.png"][/img][/p][h3]
Robot Assembler[/h3][p]An essential building that brings [b]new helpers[/b] to life. Without it, you’re basically farming with one hand tied behind your back—now lovingly [b]reworked for clarity and style[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/ec67cf2fb88988df795ca35883c3aa5ac0ae27ec.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Arboretum ([b]New building[/b] here!)[/h3][p]A dedicated structure for [b]growing trees[/b]. It won’t be in the upcoming [b]Playtests[/b] just yet—but we couldn’t resist sharing a peek.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/74cce2d4a1121b27d7169310aa165eea5ab50ec9.png"][/img][/p][h3]Technical Gateway[/h3][p]A [b]covert entrance[/b] into AgroNova’s corridors. The [b]“back door”[/b] ties directly into [b]quests[/b] and [b]narrative threads[/b]. Where does it lead? That’s for you to uncover… [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/10e3d6b0e6fd584dd8bb77955588531959f5f919.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]AgroNova Space Elevator Wreckage[/h3][p]Our location is gaining [b]history[/b] and [b]texture[/b]. You’ve seen the [b]Space Elevator[/b] concepts before; now its [b]shattered remains[/b] are taking shape [b]in-game[/b]. They add [b]mood[/b], help you [b]navigate the terrain[/b], and [b]whisper the backstory[/b] of this place. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/157e791c306e404a2d02eda1911eb90d5b7bff8a.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h3]Fence Upgrade[/h3][p]A [b]sturdier[/b], [b]smarter fence[/b] now keeps [b]Rusty[/b] from leaping off cliffs after a long day’s work. [b]Safer base[/b], fewer “whoops” moments. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/49d314cb193d72e349de34f6fced8dd4ac60e993.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Gameplay[/h1][p][/p][h3]The new Statistics menu: your base at a glance[/h3][p]We built a [b]clean[/b], [b]readable Stats menu[/b] so you always know what’s going on. Buildings now show their [b]energy[/b], [b]integrity[/b], [b]activity[/b], and [b]distance to you[/b]. The map inside the menu has [b]smooth zoom/pan[/b], [b]clear icons[/b] for the player, [b]robots[/b], and buildings, and even a [b]HUB radius[/b] so you see which [b]containers[/b] are truly connected. There’s a dedicated [b]Resources tab[/b] that tracks items not only in [b]containers[/b], but also inside [b]machines[/b], [b]drills[/b], [b]robots[/b], and [b]generators[/b]. [b]Sorting[/b] and [b]filters[/b] help you find what matters fast—and your preferences stick between refreshes.
[/p][h3]Robots that just “get it”[/h3][p][b]Automation[/b] is much [b]smarter[/b] now. The [b]Robot Gardener[/b] follows [b]sensible priorities[/b], and other won’t sprint across the entire map for no reason, and [b]nearest tasks[/b] are chosen more intelligently. [b]Repairs[/b] and [b]dismantling[/b] show proper [b]progress bars[/b], and—big win—robot jobs [b]survive saves and loads[/b], so your plans keep rolling when you return. [/p][p][/p][h3]Cargo Station & Martian cities: shop, quests, logistics[/h3][p][b]Cargo Station[/b] screens are coming to life: there’s a proper [b]shop panel[/b] with lots and a cart, [b]purchases work[/b], and [b]city shops[/b] [b]refresh every in-game hour[/b]. We’ve also introduced [b]blueprint licenses[/b], visible right in the [b]UI[/b], so you know exactly what you can unlock. This all connects to [b]quests[/b] and [b]deliveries[/b] through the station terminal. We also tuned [b]drone pad positions[/b] and [b]console interaction[/b] so the flow feels natural. [/p][p][/p][h3]In-game Encyclopedia: learn as you play[/h3][p]The old tutorial panel grew into a proper [b]Encyclopedia[/b]. It’s [b]searchable[/b], uses tidy [b]categories[/b], supports [b]rich formatting[/b], and even lets [b]pages link[/b] to each other. Entries [b]unlock as you progress[/b] (new/unlocked/locked/hidden states), and we [b]optimized[/b] it so browsing doesn’t cause [b]FPS dips[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3] Quality of life & small wins[/h3][list][*][p]Stats map icons always appear on first open; selection highlights behave after reopen.[/p][/*][*][p]Localization for [b]Building Mode UI[/b] got a big pass—[b]clearer categories[/b] and [b]labels[/b].[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Solar panels[/b] now actually [b]track the sun[/b]; your character has a mapped [b]flashlight[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]A pesky [b]main-menu crash[/b] was quashed while we refined related widgets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cinematic capture tools[/b] ([b]utility levels[/b] + [b]hi-res screenshots[/b]) help us record stable trailer footage without touching the [b]game build[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Shooting the Trailer[/h3][p]We had a blast recording new footage for the [b]gameplay video[/b]. Can’t wait to hear your [b]reactions[/b] when it premieres—see you in the [b]comments[/b] on Monday![/p][p]Link to Premiere on YouTube again[url="https://youtu.be/-HWB6JXZfhk"] here![/url] Turn on notifications! [/p][p][/p][h1]What’s Next? 😏[/h1][p]More [b]UI/UX work[/b], [b]second-round Playtest prep[/b] (including finalized [b]Statistics[/b] and [b]Map[/b] screens), finalizing [b]Greenhouse interiors[/b] and [b]Universal Compartment interiors[/b], plus interfaces for the [b]Shop[/b] and [b]Quests[/b]. And, of course, your [b]feedback[/b] will keep steering the ship. [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/-HWB6JXZfhk"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893250/AGRONOM/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]With love and gratitude,[/b][/p][p][b]The AGRONOM Team 🧡[/b][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #11: Summer Vibes & Preparing for the Next Playtest
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Martian Farmers! 🌱🚀 [/h2][p]Summer is finally here—vacation season even reached our indie studio! Half of our team is already relaxing by the sea, enjoying some well-deserved rest, while the other half has retreated to their cozy dachas to level up their gardening skills (gotta keep that farming authentic, right?). Even developers need to learn how to grow potatoes and carrots to inspire our Martian agriculture![/p][p][/p][p]Yet, despite the slower summer pace, we remain incredibly excited about the upcoming second round of AGRONOM Playtests. Your fantastic feedback has already helped us a lot, and we can't wait to show you how your suggestions have transformed the game.[/p][p][/p][h1]Visuals[/h1][p][/p][h3]Cargo Station: Now Even More Important![/h3][p]We've finished the detailed 3D model of our Cargo Station, and it's already looking fantastic! Texture creation is ahead, as well as visual effects: dust, bolts and nuts and such.  In AGRONOM, the Cargo Station isn't just decorative—it’s your first step towards building a thriving Martian base. You'll start by disassembling some of its damaged components, repurposing them to power your earliest buildings. How cool is that? [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/0b9a4fd398d98e5e8a21bc98072f6191858b35e5.png"][/img][/p][h3]Greenhouse Interior: Soviet Cozy Vibes[/h3][p]Interiors are finally coming to AGRONOM! Here's a glimpse into our Greenhouse’s current state. Inspired not just by Eastern European brutalism and monumentalism, but also by the warmth and comfort of Soviet-era homes, we're creating an authentic, cozy atmosphere that truly feels like home—even on Mars.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/9555de6431b2479a497bc4470e6eed3da36acfdf.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/f9cb1112bc183c2cd0a452bce8895720e4ed5608.png"][/img][/p][h3]Universal Compartment: Comfort Without Plants[/h3][p]We're also detailing the Universal Compartment interiors, striving to bring the same cozy feel, just without the plants. Expect atmospheric lighting, thoughtful details, and a special vibe that blends nostalgia and futuristic function perfectly. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/0f44ac67abdc28be14962f4d11158954b2bfebaf.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/86d159e2fadb19d51ba3a255213c96ee75db70b3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Technical Gateway: A Link to AgroNova’s Secrets[/h3][p]Last Devlog, we revealed concept art for the Technical Gateway. Now you can see it starting to come alive in 3D. This structure is crucial—it connects you directly to the deeper narrative, allowing you to uncover what AgroNova Corporation has been hiding. Intriguing, isn't it?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/223d71c0e6a35531a289390f8f37519143b44ed4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Space Elevator Wreckage: History in the Landscape[/h3][p]Remember the concept art for the Space Elevator wreckage? We’ve begun integrating it into the game’s environment. These pieces will not only enhance the visuals and atmosphere but also guide you around the map and reveal fascinating history about your Martian plot.   [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/50e0b357402816befe9d33efe5d64e30213ce69a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Gameplay & Programming[/h1][p][/p][h3]Smarter Robot Automation[/h3][p]We've made significant improvements to robot automation based on your feedback from the first playtests: [/p][list][*][p][b]New Gardener Robot:[/b] Calm, nature-loving, and very green, this bot carefully plants, waters, and harvests crops, making your farm efficient and vibrant.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Robot Assistant Priorities:[/b] Robots now find tasks more logically, no longer running across the map or standing idle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Detailed Statistics Screen:[/b] Quickly track your robots' locations, tasks, and battery statuses. Already, it's helped us identify and fix robot charging imbalances. Expect shorter charge times and better battery efficiency soon![/p][/*][/list][p]Automation is becoming smoother and smarter—and you'll have even more ways to optimize it further![/p][p][/p][h3]Fresh New UI for Building Mode[/h3][p]Our user interface is getting a complete overhaul, starting with the Building Mode. It’s cleaner, clearer, and friendlier—check out our progress below. Let us know how it feels to you! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/524030eed143d17930ae3bcb30ff9cf911e2c085.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]What’s Next? 😏[/h1][p]Here's a quick look at our upcoming tasks for next month:[/p][list][*][p]Continuing our comprehensive UI/UX redesign.[/p][/*][*][p]Finalizing the second round of Playtests with completed Statistics and Map screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Finishing detailed textures for the Cargo Station, Greenhouse, and Universal Compartment interiors.[/p][/*][*][p]Developing new interfaces for the Shop and Quest systems.[/p][/*][/list][p]Your ideas, suggestions, and encouragement are the very fuel that drives our development. Your comments, likes, wishlists, and discussions motivate us daily—we’re truly grateful for each and every one of you. So please, keep sharing your thoughts and suggestions. We promise: every single voice is heard and appreciated![/p][p][/p][p]What features or updates excite you the most? Let us know in the comments below—we’re always listening![/p][p][/p][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/P9dzU3sw5W"]Discord Server[/url] to chat directly with the AGRONOM Team and fellow players. And don't forget to [b]wishlist AGRONOM[/b]—your support means everything to us: [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893250/AGRONOM/"][/dynamiclink][b]With love and gratitude,[/b][/p][p][b]The AGRONOM Team 🧡[/b][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #10: New Robot, Day and Night, and AgroNova’s Secrets
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martian Farmers! 🌱🚀[/h1][p][/p][p]Thanks to your incredible support and thoughtful feedback, we have tons of exciting news to share from the AGRONOM universe. Grab your tea, buckle up, and let’s dive right into the latest developments!  [/p][p][/p][p]But first—important news! We're actively preparing the second round of Playtests for AGRONOM. You can already apply to participate, and we'll happily accept everyone! The exact Playtest dates will be announced soon. And along with the Playtests, expect to see the very first Gameplay video of AGRONOM—stay tuned![/p][p][/p][h1]Visuals[/h1][p][/p][h3]Meet Your New Robot Gardener[/h3][p]By popular demand, here’s our Robot Gardener’s concept art. This green-thumbed robot loves plants and specializes in maximizing your crop growth rates and harvesting efficiently. Excited to see it in action? We sure are!  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/f56007755cde16d7c9d21298297511df6ec9330b.png"][/img][/p][h3]Concept Art: Technical Gateway[/h3][p]Our Technical Gateway isn’t just an environment detail—it’s your window into the secrets of AgroNova Corporation. Expect bold, imposing architecture deeply inspired by Eastern European monumentalism and brutalism. Pretty atmospheric, right?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/183dd34cace9a815b66e1d51b7204552d5336b04.png"][/img][/p][h3]Concept Art: New Fence[/h3][p]Remember the quick fences from earlier Playtests? They've been transformed! Check out these beautiful concept arts—tell us your thoughts! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/9e86c7b40d67d84cdc6a48911c0bb673d3c117eb.png"][/img][/p][h3]Cargo Station: 3D Model Progress[/h3][p]Last Devlog featured the Cargo Station concept art. Now we're excited to share its 3D-model progress. We’ve enhanced details and visual storytelling—what else should we add? [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/51dbc75ec3edbd08ef912287ce452a86b054be86.png"][/img][/p][h3]Greenhouse and Airlock Models Detailed[/h3][p]Take a closer look at the near-final versions of our greenhouse and airlock. We're particularly proud of the meticulous detail. What catches your eye most? Share your feedback! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/0231b1a90880f820f3fd95ab3a64723ecee05808.png"][/img][/p][h3]Robot Helpers: Builder & Loader[/h3][p]Meet your robot friends again:  [/p][list][*][p][b]Robot Builder:[/b] Equipped with specialized tools to construct your base quickly and efficiently.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Robot Loader:[/b] Strong and sturdy, it loves hauling heavy cargo across long distances.[/p][/*][/list][p]Which helper is your favorite?[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/fd6389b520b66f14a41a8e60285a3955796365de.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/20a3da5685d89d9f23bc1f770f25ec77a4e10714.png"][/img][/p][h3]Rusty’s Latest Animations[/h3][p]Rusty, your main robotic hero, got new animations! More animations will debut in our upcoming Gameplay Video—stay tuned!  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/13815fb23c8cde1a90c723fe7f6cdc0f1c8c495f.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/f7a6e14c6fdba2844dae98be11986bac23ca43e7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Cargo Drone: Your Interplanetary Courier[/h3][p]Cargo Drones deliver produce from Gramps Makar’s farm across Mars—cities, neighbors, and even back to Makar himself! Players can also use drones to request essential supplies from friendly NPCs. What else should our drones carry?  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/b2f738091ea8b764bde41d93bf35d77bf84747bc.png"][/img][/p][h3]Eco-Friendly Tech: Sulfur Powergenerator & Bio-Generator[/h3][p]These advanced power sources generate significantly more electricity than solar or wind-based tech. You'll be able to set up intricate production chains, mining and refining ore, and crafting complex products to power your Martian base. Eco-friendly never felt so powerful! notes.title: AGRONOM Alpha Playtest Recap — Your Feedback & Future Updates! 🚀
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Martian Farmers! 🌱[/h1]

First and foremost, we’d like to express our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who participated in the [b]AGRONOM Alpha Playtest[/b]! Whether you played, streamed, created videos, or simply added our game to your wishlist—your support and feedback genuinely mean the world to our small indie team. Over [b]5,000 enthusiastic Martian farmers[/b] joined us, sharing countless valuable insights!

We openly acknowledge that the playtest build was an [b]Alpha version[/b], filled with bugs, rough edges, and plenty of areas needing improvement. Thanks to your valuable insights, we've clearly identified the strengths we should lean on, as well as the weaknesses we need to tackle immediately.

We've read [b]ALL[/b] of your feedback left on our review form, here on Steam, on our [url=https://discord.gg/P9dzU3sw5W]Discord server[/url], and many other platforms. So let's dive deeper into the specifics!

[h1]Automation 🚧[/h1]
You loved the concept of automating your Mars farm with robot helpers! Yet, you rightly pointed out that creating intuitive AI-driven automation is far more challenging than the traditional conveyor systems seen in games like [i]Factorio[/i] or [i]Satisfactory[/i]. You're absolutely correct! However, here's why we're committed to this path:
[list] [*] [b]Robots as Companions:[/b] Mars is lonely, but your robot helpers ensure it never feels empty—many of you shared touching stories of bonding with your robot companions!  
[*] [b]Specialized Helpers:[/b] Each robot has unique skills and tasks. Balancing these specializations adds depth to your strategy. We're even considering introducing a fifth robot type for better task distribution!  
[*] [b]Mars Environment:[/b] The challenging Martian weather and terrain make traditional conveyor systems impractical. Robots adapt and optimize their routes—perfect for unpredictable conditions.[/list]
You identified [b]key issues in automation[/b]:
[list] [*] Unclear how to start the first automated production chain.  
[*] Lack of visible feedback in automation tasks.  
[*] Unclear operational radius of buildings (e.g., storage outside HUB radius).  [/list]
[b]Here's how we're actively addressing your feedback:[/b] [list]  [*] Clearer, more intuitive tutorials for setting up automation.  
[*] Informative production interfaces showing assigned robots and their locations ([i]already partially implemented![/i]).  
[*] Expanded HUB functionalities with better visualization.  
[*] A comprehensive [b]Automation Dashboard[/b] showing the status of robots, buildings, and resources at a glance. [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/df462cca3c827ba32408da1de2685cb9f9cd62ec.png[/img]
[h2]Your improvement suggestions we're already working on[/h2]
[b]Enhanced Flexibility in Priority Management[/b]  
In the future, you'll gain more precise control over your automation setup. For instance, we’re currently thinking about a feature allowing players to bind specific robot helpers to designated HUBs. Each robot will have clearer and more predictable responsibilities.

Thanks to your feedback, robot AI is already significantly improved—no more frantic dashing across Mars; robots now thoughtfully complete each task before moving on.

[b]Reduced Micromanagement through Improved User Experience[/b]  
To streamline your experience and reduce micromanagement:
[list][*] [b]Comprehensive Tooltips:[/b] Hovering over resources or products displays clear, intuitive information about their entire production chains.  
[*] [b]Visual Task Indicators:[/b] Improved indicators clearly showing task statuses, ongoing processes, and robot assignments.  
[*] [b]Unified Dashboard:[/b] A central dashboard summarizing operational status of robots, resources, and production buildings at a glance. [/list]
[b]Selective Time Acceleration During Storms[/b]  
You suggested accelerating game time by 2-3x to minimize downtime. Here's our planned approach:
[list] [*] [b]Storm-Only Fast Forwarding:[/b] Selective time acceleration specifically during Martian storms.  
[*] [b]No General Acceleration:[/b] AGRONOM focuses deeply on immersive first-person automation rather than rapid pacing. [/list]
[h1]Robot Helpers 🤖[/h1]
We're delighted by how much love you've shown our robot helpers! Your fan art, screenshots, and kind words have motivated us immensely.

Based on your suggestions, we’re currently working on: [list]  
[*] More expressive animations and richer sounds to make robots feel alive.  
[*] Petting animations—because everyone deserves robot cuddles!  
[*] Robot customization options (once base visuals are perfected).  
[*] Naming robots with a random-name generator provided by your favorite Martian grandpa, [i]Gramps Makar[/i]. [/list] Additionally, we're exploring unique robot languages, enabling robots to express emotions and interact naturally!

[h1]Visuals & Atmosphere 🖼️[/h1]
Thank you for your kind words about AGRONOM's visual style! Even though many assets were unfinished, your excitement showed us we’re on the right path.

Here's what we're improving: [list]  
[*] Varied Martian landscapes and environmental storytelling ([i]sneak peeks in Devlog #9![/i]).  
[*] Visible player body and animations coming soon (meet Rusty!).  
[*] Adding a Jump mechanic? If we get [b]25 more comments asking for jump[/b], we'll officially add it to our roadmap![/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/87baec064bb0e7a25d0a1cfdde2f13c406855cc1.png[/img]

[h1]Sound & Music 🎵[/h1]
Your enthusiasm encouraged us to continue collaboration with audio specialists:
[list] [*] More diverse background music.  
[*] Adjusting repetitive sounds to be softer.  
[*] Expanding sound effects library (including delivery drone audio!).  
[/list]
[h1]Other Game Mechanics 🛠️[/h1]
[list] [*] [b]Building mechanics:[/b] Improved cable connections already updated!  
[*] [b]Greenhouse management:[/b] Environmental controllers with clearer interfaces soon.  
[*] [b]Infinite vegetable production:[/b] Carefully evaluating your ideas here!  
[*] [b]Map/Compass:[/b] Considering detailed Mars terrain map.  
[*] [b]Side Quests:[/b] Interact with neighbors, fulfill special orders, and earn exciting upgrades!  
[*] [b]Technical Issues:[/b] Optimizing performance, fixing bugs, and enhancing stability continuously.  
[*] [b]In-game Encyclopedia:[/b] Detailed descriptions of constructions, resources, lore, and characters coming soon.  
[/list]
[h1]User Interface & Tutorials 📚[/h1]
You clearly let us know that the user interface and tutorial system were among the weakest aspects during the playtest—and guess what? We totally agree! That’s why we're actively working on completely revamping these systems right now.

Here’s exactly what we’re working on, and what’s coming soon:
[list]
[*]We're fully redesigning the logic behind the [b]Cargo Station[/b] to make exchanging resources, completing quests and orders, and using the shop more intuitive and user-friendly.
[*]Next, we’ll focus on visuals: brand new, cohesive UI elements are coming, crafted entirely from scratch to perfectly match the cozy atmosphere of AGRONOM.
[*]The building menu is also undergoing significant reconsideration. We're committed to maintaining gamepad convenience, while also greatly enhancing the user experience for keyboard and mouse players. Comfortable gameplay on all devices remains our top priority!
[*]And of course, we haven’t forgotten your justified feedback about huge walls of tutorial text. Trust us, we didn’t like them either! 😅 So we're working hard to ensure tutorials become smoother, more natural, and seamlessly integrated into gameplay. Instead of endless reading, we’ll enjoy clear hints and subtle, organic learning experiences woven directly into the game itself.
[/list]
[h1]Final Thoughts 🚀[/h1]
Our small but passionate team embarked on an ambitious journey, and your feedback has become our guiding star. Automating a farm with charming robot helpers deeply resonates with you, and this fills us with pride and excitement!

We have plenty of work ahead, but your enthusiasm inspires us every step of the way. Let's shape AGRONOM into the game you'll truly love.

[b]Thank you again for being amazing playtesters! Together, we're creating the best automation game filled with adorable robots and cozy Martian adventures![/b]

Don't forget to join our friendly community on [url=https://discord.gg/P9dzU3sw5W]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts and ideas.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893250/AGRONOM/
With love,  
[b]The AGRONOM Team 🚀🤖🌱[/b]

notes.title: Devlog #9: Trailer Success, Playtest Feedback & Visual Upgrades!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martian Farmers! 🌱🚀[/h1]

This month has been incredibly inspiring for us and for [b]AGRONOM[/b]! We launched our Announcement Trailer, which has already surpassed over 200,000 views! Our warm and supportive community is also growing steadily (if you haven't joined our [url=https://discord.gg/P9dzU3sw5W][b]Discord[/b][/url] yet—now’s the perfect time!). Additionally, we ran large-scale playtests involving over 5,000 participants, providing invaluable feedback. We're carefully reading, analyzing, and integrating your suggestions into our development process. We'll soon share detailed insights on how your feedback has directly impacted the game’s evolution, so stay tuned!

We also launched a fantastic [url=https://cybermag.es][b]new website[/b][/url] where you can pet our robots (yes, really!) and subscribe to our newsletter for all the freshest updates.

[h1]Visuals[/h1]

[h3]Cargo Platform is now Cargo Station![/h3]
We’ve updated the [b]Cargo Platform[/b] to [b]Cargo Station[/b] to better reflect its significance. It's now the first building you'll encounter on your empty plot, helping you kickstart base development.

The [b]Cargo Station[/b] is the central building of your plot! It connects to a big delivery network across Mars. Through this station, you can send and receive cargo, making sure your base always has what it needs to grow.

Installed by the [b]AgroNova Corporation[/b] long ago, our [b]Cargo Station[/b] was left unused, becoming partially damaged over time. It's one-of-a-kind—you can't build another, and there's only one on your Martian base! [b]Rusty[/b] uses parts from these ruins to help rebuild the station and start developing your base.

Every [b]Cargo Station[/b] has a built-in generator providing a steady, reliable source of energy. It's not incredibly powerful, but more than enough to support the initial development of your Martian base. Below, you can check out the concept art for the redesigned [b]Cargo Station[/b]—let us know what you think!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/e42e6fdef2fd5a7a270a33184ffcc5b29cef76c4.png[/img]
[h3]Concept Art of Mars Environment[/h3] We're beginning to diversify our Martian landscapes—especially around Gramps Makar’s plot and its surroundings. Enjoy this early glimpse into the future beauty of our Martian environment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/87baec064bb0e7a25d0a1cfdde2f13c406855cc1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/57ff890533b60265413ef4d7e910d833a7edc0bd.png[/img]

[h3]Builder Robot Animations[/h3] Our robots have been getting a lot of love, and it makes us happy to see your enthusiasm! Check out the incredible new animations of our Builder Robot—what a character!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/2b612aad5f28f6965fcb172bfa9be5d3b9bf5171.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/f643f4c5d4f1f560165f9566499765020efbe86d.gif[/img]
[h3]Robot Assembler[/h3] Here's the machine you'll use to assemble your trusty robot helpers. Pretty cool, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/896b653d7083fa5140a41eeecce68017903056f7.gif[/img]

[h2]Enhanced 3D Models[/h2]
We've been working extensively to refine our 3D models. Previously, in our trailer and playtests, you saw basic "blockout" models—simplified versions for faster prototyping. Now, we're ready to showcase near-final models with richer details and textures. Buildings are looking more vibrant and engaging than ever!

Check out the updated [b]Universal Compartment[/b], complete with intricate wiring and buttons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/fa776e0076f6947f5b6f4cdcc4b4c1acdafa6969.png[/img]
Here are improved models of the [b]Cooking Station[/b] and [b]Composter[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/442495d14c751a29d64b25e98ae9187e36d18a86.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/84aa19be94f86256241308a4548806f297037648.png[/img]
And introducing, for the first time—the [b]Geo Scanner[/b]! The [b]Geo Scanner[/b] is a quest-related item that will help you discover hidden secrets on Mars—things you were not meant to know!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/11c7b5e5db529ac4b7c3fc0630b36c8f90affee5.png[/img]

[h1]Environment[/h1] This month, our landscape received significant optimizations:
[list] [*] Material optimization from a singular heavy-load material to a layered and blended approach. [*] New engine updates enabling height-based blending between layers, greatly enhancing visual realism. [*] Transitioning to the updated engine version also enabled us to use Nanite technology, allowing for displacement maps that create much more realistic and dynamic terrain. [/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/ab4e4fd65ac718626ce5a1b1a1c95a9d64445a5d.png[/img]
We're also working on visualizing new environmental concept arts. Check out these fresh screenshots straight from the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/c2205655528d76eb8ff73928c76d0a59e9835114.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/e82580b3f3aaf59bb2c33b11c4d6b9acd2306967.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1] We've completed programming the storyline for our playtests, a prequel introducing Gramps Makar and Auntie Masha. Following the release, we quickly deployed two updates to support playtests and have now moved on to new challenges—like redesigning and updating the logic and interfaces of the Cargo Station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/d0669320f817287aa572442d34d1c0bede15871f.png[/img]

[h1]Narrative[/h1] We’ve developed and integrated a compelling prequel narrative for [b]AGRONOM[/b]. In this prequel (featured in playtests and soon in our Demo), you'll experience events several years before the main storyline. Step into [b]Rusty[/b]'s shoes for his first field trial under Gramps Makar’s supervision. Help Auntie Masha manage her farm while she's delayed on an interplanetary trip—especially with [b]AgroNova Corporation[/b] eagerly awaiting their cut of the harvest!

This prequel lets you explore Auntie Masha’s farm, while in the main game, you'll build your own base from scratch on Gramps Makar’s land.

[h1]What’s Next? 😏[/h1] This month, we aim to finalize core gameplay mechanics, enhance our 3D models, and introduce exciting new animations. We'll also simplify and improve the introductory tutorial experience based on your feedback. After fully analyzing your suggestions, we'll integrate new features—details to be revealed early next week!

And for those who read to the very end—here’s a little surprise! We've started working on a gameplay teaser! Let us know in the comments what you're most excited about and want to see! Stay tuned for more updates!

For more details, join our [url=https://discord.gg/P9dzU3sw5W][b]Discord server[/b][/url].
And don't forget to [b]wishlist AGRONOM[/b]—your support truly means everything to us:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893250/AGRONOM/

With love,
[b]The AGRONOM Team[/b] 🧡

notes.title: Devlog #6: Automation and Robot animations
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martian Farmers! 🌱🚀[/h1]
Another brilliant month in AGRONOM’s development has passed, and we’re excited to share the highlights of our achievements! We continue to create unique automation mechanics with our robots, refine our 3D models and animations, and prepare something truly special just for you.

[h1]Visuals[/h1] 
[h2][b]Concepts of New and Updated Buildings[/b][/h2]

[h3]Geoscanner[/h3]
Equipment designed to create a detailed 3D map of ore deposits and underground structures on a small plot. Imagine how technology can unlock the secrets of Mars!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/d9e160ca3fd6ab114fb337d60ef27a2e465c75e3.png[/img]
[h3]Incubator[/h3]
A familiar structure in an entirely new form. The old Incubator used to spin and tower with multiple floors, which made it hard for helper robots to reach the upper levels. Now it’s styled to perfection and intuitively designed — get ready for a new era of incubation!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/c740f7c80d6e4de0fe19d1499050c8c332820e25.png[/img]
[h3]Biogenerator[/h3]
This machine will boost your energy production for automation. Feed it weeds or coal, and you’ll receive pure energy with a scientific twist!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/4bdf54678874f13c179f07854fb19b1c66b4fa7b.png[/img]
[h3]Sulfur Powergenerator[/h3]
A device that extracts uncompromised energy from sulfur and its derivatives. Set it up outdoors, configure the production chain – and watch as the robots collect and process sulfur to power your Martian home.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/2217269ff8b8334191050e58eaa3002a955d3c6e.png[/img]
[h2][b]3D Models and Animations[/b][/h2] 
[h3]Robot Animations[/h3]
This month, we focused on robot animations – particularly for the assistant robot. We’re excited to show you two of them. The first one demonstrates a smooth shutdown when the robot is deactivated, while the second features a combined movement: a step enhanced by dynamic motion on wheels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/1a24e37ff284c7dd5eff5121acfa626e4771c32a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/ab8f6ccb51399c3f15d624e8ef41117118c55417.gif[/img]

[h3]Robot Movement[/h3]
We are currently working on two movement modes for the assistant robot, the builder and the worker! The loader robot is heavier and more swivelling, so its locomotion will be different from its brethren. One mode of locomotion is already shown above - combining the power of legs and the advantages of wheels to move confidently across the varied Martian landscape.  

The second mode, designed for indoor environments like greenhouses and other structures, will allow robots to move smoothly and rapidly on flat, artificial surfaces using wheels only. To achieve these movement types, we use IK (Inverse Kinematics) technology — it automatically adjusts the positioning of the legs to match the terrain. Thanks to this, each step is perfectly calibrated, whether it’s a small hill, a stone, a pit, or an inclined surface. We’re confident our robots will move much faster than Curiosity Rover!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/ffe02b71fbff297a071497107a958f22a49b440d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/a9ad88c3b1694cee26afcbcd97e97af785ec44e0.png[/img]
[h3]Assistant Robot[/h3]
Take a look at the high-detail view of our assistant robot. We’ve fine-tuned even more details and refined its mechanisms to ensure it’s not only charming but also technically flawless.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/d64949d3df227ff19d6bc84db27a3356973cd3e1.png[/img]
[h3]HUB[/h3]
The HUB is the heart of automation and one of the most prominent objects in the game. We’re currently perfecting its model because, with the HUB, you’ll be able to monitor your robots and their tasks via a mini-map, as well as customize automation for various objects in your play area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/5a0165a0bc2ea3f457da1561b8f0dcc5fe21696a.png[/img]

[h1]Environment[/h1]
We tested the map within our team and improved the landscape of Uncle Makar’s plot. For example, a new hill was added to improve orientation in space. We also developed a prototype fence, a relic from previous owners, that defines the boundaries of your play area — so you never get lost or take a tumble. And who knows? 
We are also now designing other objects of the previous attempt to colonise this site. Perhaps Uncle Makar will let you dismantle a few if you behave yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/66e866a44bd585a24db24f0631610fe53415bdb5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/7857a4e5be41c744cabbfc0ed1ce274d27b6000a.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
This month, we paid special attention to automating plant cultivation. Our robots now take better care of plants, harvest more efficiently, and correctly prioritize greenhouse tasks while not neglecting other duties. Everything is set up to create the ideal production chain for your Martian farm. We’re also continuing to integrate and fine-tune new and updated 3D models into the game, along with refining robot and building animations. All models are in place! Check out a few screenshots:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/85455b1a56f3ab5ae24c99085756c0317f202742.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/649e10f2a4bd58dd67a4ca98584402911dd0b3aa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/79c0b90b1ccc549389f449ba2addf4dfab4d2238.png[/img]

[h1]What’s Next? 😏[/h1]
Very soon, we’ll share details about an important Festival that we’re incredibly proud and excited to participate in! We're preparing a brand-new trailer for you that's going to be an absolute bomb, and the imminent news with the announcement of our participation in the Festival will give great news for fans of the genre!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/44a4adcc8b27ea97989b2fdf4d180ded3c4a687a.png[/img]
For more details, join our [url=https://discord.gg/P9dzU3sw5W]Discord server[/url].
And don’t forget to [b]wishlist AGRONOM[/b] — your support is priceless to us:

notes.title: Devlog #5: Holidays, Work, Holidays, Work
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martian farmers! 🌱🚀[/h1]

Happy New Year and belated Merry Christmas to all our readers! 🎄✨ This month marks a small milestone for us: welcome to the fifth devlog for [b]AGRONOM[/b]! Thank you for being part of this journey. We hope you had a joyful and restful holiday season — we certainly did. But don’t worry, we didn’t slack off too much. Between celebrating and reflecting, we had time to get a lot done. Stick around to see what’s new!

[h1]Visuals[/h1]

[h3][b]Concepts of new buildings[/b][/h3]
[h3]Robot Assembler[/h3]
A specialized machine designed to assemble helper robots for automating your farm. Below are three visuals: an initial concept by our art lead, design details outlining interactivity and animations, and progress on the 3D model.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/5f576ff1ba6000319c563e28ec4109fe1ec69703.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/553c10e237cf60dcb42b9dddb8077ce165c8a4c4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/8a09cdcfc4ed114c167271fea2044d3dd6562f4b.png[/img]

[h3]Robot Charging Station[/h3]
This structure will serve as a recharging hub for robots. Imagine robotic vacuum cleaners heading back to their docks to recharge — except on Mars! Robots need more than just quick energy breaks — they also deserve a little recharge through five-minute dance sessions! And don’t forget to interact with them and give them a pat behind the ears. You wouldn’t want to lose that special connection, would you? Robots will automatically make their way here when their energy runs low.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/506c22f06e6d2f086a3ad3990270fe4f55de1d91.png[/img]

[h3]Universal Compartment[/h3]
A hub for players where most crafting machines can be installed. It’s a safe haven from Martian storms and a perfect space to strategize your next greenhouse setup. Check out the external and internal concepts!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/4b8bc0271a0c809d28942a1b0c6c8c97f5a2e570.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/1091e63666acf0612cdefba176ddb1b3c6393fad.png[/img]

[h3]Arboretum[/h3]
Designed for larger plants like trees, this new building lets you grow and nurture Martian flora without worrying about flooding the floors. (We’re serious — no flooding here!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/824bada85425cf1b20b92465cddf476850db2f5e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Working on 3D models and updating the designs of familiar buildings[/b][/h3]
[h3]Rusty the Robot[/h3]
In the last devlog, we showcased Rusty’s new concept art. Now we’re excited to reveal its 3D visualization!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/68fd0502a3bb6ab47e4aac8f68bf39ef4ae146d7.png[/img]

[h3]Updated HUB Concept[/h3]
The HUB (Household Utility Base) is a crucial structure in [b]AGRONOM[/b], serving as the command center for helper robots and defining the boundaries of their operations. The new HUB design is taller, covering much larger areas than before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/482ec43584d7ee9d8e66df64e7472ac4e1542e9d.png[/img]

[h3]Electric Pole[/h3]
Its design remains consistent with the previous version, featuring a birch-like trunk inspired by Uncle Makar’s memories of Earth. We’ve added variations for the top section, allowing for upgrades and expanded device connectivity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/3a1d1c1f9fef3f5ca7fc4e39c6653115d3f023f0.png[/img]

[h3]Greenhouse Interior[/h3]
Here’s a sneak peek at the ongoing work on the greenhouse interior! The design team is collaborating with 3D artists to define lighting sources and identify interactive elements. It’s all coming together beautifully, wouldn’t you agree?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/25972075bf263a1ebf5e50ad317fb578dd22e6ce.png[/img]

[h3]Wind Generator[/h3]
This concept has undergone further refinements since its last iteration. The updated design is more recognizable and fits seamlessly within [b]AGRONOM’s[/b] aesthetic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/3581b0b427e98bf4aae3fc946f30e16375039775.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/682f4111ed606356e13cfd7985ba623c3ac8bc9e.png[/img]

[h3]Solar Panel[/h3]
Sunflowers were something Uncle Makar knew well. He used to sit on the bench in front of the house and chew seeds, enjoying the simple pleasure of the moment. Take a look at our 3D workup on this model.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/a82af0a3910020002647bf777d752be04c256022.png[/img]

[h1]Environment[/h1] 

We’ve been hard at work bringing life (and rocks) to the surface of Mars! This month, we integrated ore deposits into the new map. These deposits don’t just look good — they’re inspired by real photos from the [b]Curiosity rover[/b], ensuring they feel natural and believable. 

On top of that, we’ve begun testing and balancing the map with our updated buildings. Our focus? Ensuring there’s plenty of room for smooth and stress-free [b]base building[/b]. After all, a Martian colony should be as efficient as it is enjoyable to construct — so you can focus on building your dream Martian base without stress!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/38f9f8bbcad0f46552f9998b7b9e78a276b57265.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/b0da457bb1fdbdad624feeb40f81e2beb6f70e6c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/72a1a79dc5948530154e81a31a24d23c032de2ad.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
Our programming team has been busy this month with updates and fixes to improve your gameplay experience. Here are the highlights:
[list]
[*]We introduced a new quest: “[b]Automation Training[/b],” which unlocks after completing “[b]Mars, Farm, and Robots[/b]” This quest will teach you the basics of setting up automated workflows, a crucial skill for running an efficient Martian base.
[*][b]Specialized Robots[/b] are here! Each robot, except for assistants, now sticks to its primary task, making your automation workflow more streamlined and predictable.
[*]We’ve doubled the build radius of the HUB, giving you [b]more freedom[/b] to expand your colony.
[*]Conducted [b]experiments to improve[/b] user experience with [b]automation [/b]and customisation of our robotic pipelines.
[*]Large structures like compartments and greenhouses now have temporary lighting to make your [b]base feel alive [/b]even in its early stages.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/fa040c151122bb2f64601f7e80e89e348cc4139f.png[/img]
[h1]Narrative[/h1] 
This month, we focused heavily on testing new quests and models, ensuring they integrate smoothly into the overall experience. We’ve also been fine-tuning the balance of automation systems and farming mechanics on the new map. Our universal compartment saw a major update — it’s now a central hub for all crafting machines, creating a cohesive and functional workflow for you.

On the audio side, we began working with sound engineers to define the game’s auditory identity. From mechanical whirs to the soothing hum of greenhouses, every sound will contribute to the immersive Martian farming experience. We’re compiling references and creating a detailed list for our first round of sound integration.

[h2]Coming Soon 😏[/h2]
Here’s what’s next for AGRONOM:
[list][*] We are continuing to [b]optimize [/b]the most complex algorithmic aspect of the game — [b]the automation of robots[/b] and how HUBs distribute tasks. Our goal is to ensure the gameplay remains intuitive and comfortable for you. Robots should assist with every task because, let’s face it, managing Mars solo is a bit much!
[*] Wrapping up the [b]development [/b]and [b]integration [/b]of [b]new models[/b]: from buildings to robots with animations.
[*] [b]Creating sounds[/b] and [b]music[/b]. Special mention goes to their integration into the game, where we’re implementing procedural sound adaptation technologies to enhance the experience.
[*] [b]Conducting [/b]testing and [b]balance optimization[/b]. Feedback constantly reveals new opportunities for improvement, pushing us to refine quests and rewards, building schemes, resource creation, and more.
[/list]
That’s all for this month’s devlog! We’re thrilled to keep sharing our progress with you. Your feedback, suggestions, and support mean everything to us. Let us know what you think about these updates — drop a comment below or join the discussion on our [url=https://discord.gg/P9dzU3sw5W]Discord[/url]. Until next time, keep farming those Martian dreams! 🚜✨ And remember, even Mars can feel like home with the right crops!

And don’t forget to [b]wishlist AGRONOM[/b] if you haven’t already: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893250/AGRONOM/

With love,
[b]The AGRONOM Team[/b] 🧡

notes.title: Devlog #4: Rusty, Quests, and Drones
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martian farmers! 🌱🚀[/h1]
Welcome to the fourth chapter of our devlog series! This month, we’ve focused on refining systems, expanding gameplay features, and adding exciting new tools to your future Martian colony. While [b]AGRONOM[/b] is still in development, we’re thrilled to share a glimpse of the improvements we’ve been working on. 

Your continued support through wishlisting and feedback means the world to us! 🧡

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
We’re continuing to push the boundaries of visual design and are thrilled to share this month’s updates with you! Our team has been refining models introduced earlier and creating exciting new concepts and 3D models. 

[h3]Rusty’s Updated Concept[/h3]  
Meet the robot farmer you’ll play as in [b]AGRONOM[/b]! [b]Rusty [/b]now has legs instead of wheels, plus more functional arms and body. [b]Rusty's [/b]model is already in production, so we're excited to share a render of the main character soon too! What do you think of the new design? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/44e60e4dc83b172d7652370e37e86cbf88ecdde1.png[/img]

[h3]Robot Models and Animations[/h3]  
We’re excited to reveal the 3D renders of our assistant and loader robots, as well as their first animations. The assistant demonstrates its manipulator extension, while the loader showcases the folding and unfolding of its crane. These models are still in progress, with more details coming in future iterations.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/93f53a68259690233f8661546c5073785989e616.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/449eb6fcc2aea4b316ff437619cb41673061b47e.gif[/img]

[h3]Cargo Platform and Drone[/h3]  
We teased its concept in the previous devlog, and now we’re ready to share the 3D model. The platform evolves through [b]four stages[/b], starting with a basic platform and expanding with up to three compartments for larger shipments. Check out the GIF and renders. You can see the texture map behind the model renders, more on that below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/616f694b69599be520249d15447770cbc3dbaf4c.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/e0703ce8d7f03fe1549b61f475c1a4701af27f77.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/3240fc412b0e1052c48aa8da730a9741ee85b325.jpg[/img]

[h3]Resource Packages[/h3]  
These serve as the physical representations of all dense and liquid materials in the game. From water and ores to ready-made meals, they’re how resources are transported in [b]AGRONOM[/b]. Below, you’ll see a concept that highlights the differences between containers for solid and liquid materials. The final reference has evolved, along with the 3D model. Take a look at both the concept and the final render!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/0d419cac56fa181d0f25cb8b798839c346624031.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/9126ecc1557bd43a09c304663dd5fc2f6f727989.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Garden Bed[/h3]  
A new garden bed design is ready for its greenhouse! With enhanced dimensions and an updated look, it’s perfect for growing your Martian crops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/597951d53de691922f59d9e5574d1e684f7915f0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Dirty Details[/h3]  
To create an authentic Martian sand dust mud, we studied a lot of photos and videos from the [b]Curiosity rover[/b], watching how dirty it gets. And then we worked out a pattern by which we add sand to all the buildings and robots. Look at the dirty robot and the comparison of a clean and dusty furnance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/1ba186902ca161853fb6b3a83d41558541e53f0b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/8171e9148f01aaa2cda9c83639674904a7102b66.jpg[/img]

[h3]Optimized Textures[/h3]  
To ensure smooth performance, we use temporary color codes to simplify texturing processes before applying the final textures.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/5c32d2e2cd2b66cbfda75d8eda13f7022bd5b786.jpg[/img]

[h3]Solar Panel Concept[/h3]  
While not drastically different from earlier designs, the updated concept fits better with [b]AGRONOM’s [/b]overall style and setting.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/b5305f56eb36cc6841b387f8aa41ccdc6153ea14.png[/img]

[h3]Environment[/h3]  
In addition to modeling detailed areas like the iconic archway, we’re optimizing the map for high-quality textures and smooth performance. So that as many of you as possible can play our game and with maximum high quality textures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/43647d9250229e323489afc10329e166a6b20ad9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[h3]Crafting and Automation[/h3]  
Last month, we made significant updates to the mechanics of automation, and this month we focused on improving the player experience through thorough testing. While testing, we identified collisions between robot workflows and crafting machines. To address this, we updated the crafting machine logic to allow robots to seamlessly execute long-term plans. However, we also noticed that robots sometimes interfered with manual crafting. To resolve this, crafting machines now work more intuitively:  
[list]  
[*] Recipes are added to the plan only when required for automation.  
[*] Machines in manual use temporarily ignore robot interactions, ensuring uninterrupted gameplay.  
[/list]
[h3]Quest System Enhancements[/h3]  
The quest system, first introduced in our technical demo, is growing into a richer experience. We’ve added an introductory quest chain designed to guide you through the basics of Martian farming. New mechanics like quest markers make it easier to track objectives without getting lost.

Standard disclaimer about game screenshots: [i]Screens are not a representation of the final result. The map, 3D models, quests, and interface may change during development[/i] 💅

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/5a12002b878f310be10a423edf629f38aa745a06.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/904fb6994daf07b4948b7c7a040beece65917ef8.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Resource: Concrete[/h3]  
Say hello to [b]Concrete[/b], your new go-to resource for advanced construction and upgrades. Unlockable through the [b]"Learning Electricity" quest[/b], Concrete adds a fresh dimension to your colony-building strategies.

[h3]Energy Network Simplification[/h3]  
Energy management has been streamlined — no more “charging mode”! Your power networks now operate continuously as long as a generator or battery is connected, ensuring smoother gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/af8ca366e4b22f503007c22c7705d9defbbfe1ae.jpg[/img]

[h2]Story[/h2]  
Our narrative design has reached new heights this month, expanding the world of AGRONOM with interconnected stories and engaging characters.  

You’ll begin your journey by landing on Mars and constructing a [b]Cargo Platform[/b], your lifeline to Uncle Makar — your creator, who remains in Mars’ orbit — and a host of other characters, including your neighbors on the Martian homestead.  

We’ve crafted quests that are not just side activities but integral to the game’s heart. Parallel quest lines let you interact with characters and get to know them better. Forming a Martian farming community allows you to get unique schemes that only certain characters can share. The story embodies the cooperative spirit of rural life, where neighbors help one another, solve problems together, and celebrate shared successes.  

Take a look at our [b]quest relationship map[/b], which shows how quests interconnect, creating a dynamic and evolving narrative experience.
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/b02507cfc2aeb62f73cdc9245d5213e953514379.jpg[/img]

[h2]Coming Soon 😏[/h2]
Here’s what’s next for AGRONOM:  
[list]  
[*] Creating animations for robots, including actions, idle states, and interactions.  
[*] Designing concepts for remaining structures, detailing robots, buildings, and greenhouses, and developing compartments and interior finishes for greenhouses.  
[*] Integrating and fine-tuning most of the updated and new models on the new map.  
[*] Starting work on sound effects and music with a professional studio, with plans to integrate the first part next month! [/list]

Stay resourceful, stay inventive, and keep dreaming of Mars! 🚜✨

notes.title: Devlog #3: Automation Kicks Into Gear!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martian farmers! 🌱🚀[/h1]
Welcome back to the third chapter of our devlog series! We've been powering through a ton of exciting updates this month, getting deeper into automation, refining visuals, and even setting up a storm for Mars. From updated landscapes to expanding character stories, there's a lot to unpack. And as always, your support by wishlisting AGRONOM keeps our engines running! 🧡

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
Our art team has been busy crafting essential models for the game, giving Mars its industrial charm and farming capabilities. We’re tackling everything from production stations (like a furnace and cooking station with their industrial upgrades) to resource processors, including a seed extractor and composter.

This month, we focused on the initial blockouts, giving these structures a strong visual foundation. We also experimented with concepts for the interiors of greenhouses and the layout of a cargo platform, setting the stage for more functional and visually cohesive environments. Each model is crafted to feel right at home on Mars, yet designed to maximize efficiency.

And as a special behind-the-scenes treat, we’re including a render of one of our models straight out of Maya! Let us know what you think in the comments or on our [url=https://discord.gg/P9dzU3sw5W]Discord[/url].

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

Our team made a major move this month — we migrated to a brand-new map! We’re talking expanded terrain, fresh resource nodes, and optimized paths to ease navigation across rugged Martian landscapes. This new map layout opens up exciting possibilities for exploration and automation, and we can’t wait for you to experience its secrets. Here’s a sneak peek:

We prepared a time-lapse showing how your bots will farm, gather, and produce resources, turning raw Martian soil into productive farmland. [h2]Environment[/h2]

You’ll need to stay alert and protect your assets, especially your greenhouses and robotic companions, when the storm hits. Mars might be harsh, but we’re making sure it’s worth the struggle! They’re a dynamic force, bringing an immersive challenge that impacts visibility, equipment functionality, and your ability to safely navigate. 
[list]
[*] Sandstorms can damage most surface structures. Robots must repair damaged buildings to keep them functional.
[*] The Solar Generator shuts down, but the Wind Generator's efficiency increases.
[*] Cargo Platforms are temporarily offline, and any resources left outside are lost to the winds.
[/list] Get ready to navigate these challenges and see how storms add an extra layer of strategy to your Martian operations.

notes.title: Devlog #2: We're working on automation!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martian farmers! 🌱🚀[/h1]
Welcome to our second devlog! We're equal parts excited and a little scared to share our latest progress with you. But hey, if indie teams weren’t strong of heart, they’d have starved long ago, right? Well, we’ve got snacks, so we’re good! 😅

Your support by adding AGRONOM to your wishlist is literally our lifeline 🧡

[h2]Visual[/h2]
We’ve continued working on updated concepts for key buildings to align them with our established visual style.

But the real stars of the show? Our robots! The previous designs had some mixed reactions — some found them cute and harmless, while others thought they looked like little spiders (yikes!). But that’s all in the past! We’ve completely revamped them, and we’re excited to share the new designs, which are already being turned into 3D models.

[b]We NEED your opinion about robot-assistant and robot-worker![/b]
Are they winning your heart, or giving you the heebie-jeebies? Drop down into the comments and let us know, or join our [url=https://discord.gg/P9dzU3sw5W]Discord[/url] to chat with us directly. Your feedback matters and could shape the final designs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/497ec2139ace190059c4e44f982b762dc1866715.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/69b23e2d9d6d48fd04d989ab9c57a3882d0dd444.png[/img]

Last devlog, we mentioned the work we did on the greenhouse and its surroundings. This month, besides the robots, we also worked on concept art for important buildings like the [b]Multicooker[/b], [b]Seed Extractor[/b], and [b]Furnace[/b]. And we even worked on some character concepts for our story! But we’ll share those with you a little later 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/c3431f2459e61dc205f10c76a9e5c2879fee1d40.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/e491938ebe697b153d90cf8d04541f1de9bfc0ba.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/3af12000ecaac4109fd4d6a455bc420700396a26.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
This month, our game designers and programmers have been hard at work improving the automation system. As a quick reminder, automation in AGRONOM revolves around robots — Mars farming bots, essentially. With their help, you can automate everything: from resource extraction to food production, pickling, and even hot meals. Who knew survival on Mars could be so gourmet? 😋

Starting a farm from scratch on Mars is no walk in the park. You’ll have to mine ores, build greenhouses, plant seeds, and manage water and electricity. Seems like a lot for one person, right? Especially when you’re scaling up! Watching over one tomato plant is manageable, but what if you’ve got a dozen? And then throw in strawberries, potatoes, beets, and sunflowers. Soon, you’ll have mini-farms, not to mention multiple greenhouses. That’s where the robots come to the rescue!

[b]So why robots and not conveyor belts, like in [i]Satisfactory [/i]or [i]Factorio[/i]?[/b]
Good question! Mars is all about dust storms and scattered debris — your resources would fly all over the place, and those conveyor belts would break down faster than you could say “rust!”. On the other hand, robots can handle rough terrain, and they'll even seek shelter in your greenhouses during a thunderstorm. They're pretty clever, aren't they? 😉

This month, we gave you more control over your robot helpers. Now you can manage their tasks and priorities through the hub. Here’s what you can do:
[list]
[*] View all surrounding buildings and see your bots scurrying around.
[*] Check what each bot is working on.
[*] Assign tasks to bots, like mining 10 units of iron ore or producing 2 units of plastic. You can even prioritize tasks based on what’s most important to you.
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/544efee36221ac69b41982dfd709189ebda95dc6.png[/img]
[h2]Environment[/h2]
Level design is in full swing! Here’s what we’ve been working on:
[list]
[*] [b]Terrain adjustments:[/b] Ensuring players and robots can easily navigate, with plenty of space for large buildings like greenhouses.
[*] [b]Stylization:[/b] We’re going for a realistic yet stylized look. We’ve been studying the latest Mars rover photos to match our map’s colors and textures with the real thing.
[*] [b]Texture improvements:[/b] Balancing high-detail textures with performance, so everything runs smoothly.
[*] [b]Environment work:[/b] Mars may be mostly sand and rocks, but we’re using these limited tools to create an engaging landscape that draws the eye.
[*] [b]Resource balance:[/b] Placing ores around the map, balancing progression so you can access resources as you advance.
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/dc4e62e4e33028b8240b3fb3d55eaa1fa6d49675.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/2d12600cfba07a41b2c19d29c97d3d23c6db922b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/965f7e482743267fc80a0cab87ad956a93ee24b3.png[/img]
[h2]Story[/h2]
This month, we dove deeper into the game’s narrative, expanding on the lore behind Rusty — the farming robot you’ll be playing as — and writing the dramatic backstory of Uncle Makar. He’s your trusty guide and main narrative character. Uncle Makar’s no-nonsense, but don’t let that fool you — he’s got a heart somewhere under that stern look. Just don’t ask him to smile! 😅

We’ve also been developing the in-game shop, where you’ll be able to trade with other Martians, buy schematics, seeds, and accessories to customize your experience. We’re also mapping out unique quest items to spice things up.

[h1]Coming Soon 😏[/h1]
Each month, we push ourselves with bigger, more complex goals to make AGRONOM not only a fun and beautiful game but also one with a vibrant fanbase. We’re working hard to improve both gameplay mechanics and visuals. Oh, and we’ve started working on a new trailer! Fingers crossed we can surprise you with it by the end of the year.

In the coming month, we’ll be refining the automation system, finalizing robot 3D models and animations, and enhancing AI. We’re adding new buildings and refining existing ones. On the narrative side, we’ll integrate the quest system and continue fleshing out the story. We’ve also started working on making the Martian sky more realistic. Soon, you’ll see the moons Phobos and Deimos floating above your colony!

[b]As always, we LOVE hearing from you![/b] Tell us what you think about the new robots, share your thoughts on [url=https://discord.gg/P9dzU3sw5W]Discord[/url], or drop a comment below. Your feedback really makes a difference and could even influence the final game! 😊

notes.title: Devlog #1: Back from the Summer Fields of Mars!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martians farmers! 🌱🚀[/h1]

It’s been a while since we last saw each other at the Farming Fest! We hope you’re still out there sowing seeds, harvesting dreams, and avoiding the occasional dust storm on Mars.

Today is [b]special[/b]. Why? Because it’s the first [b]devlog[/b] of [b]AGRONOM [/b]— the coziest farming automation game this side of the galaxy. 

Since the Farming Fest, our little robot team at [b]CyberMages Studio[/b] has been working nonstop (it’s okay, they don't need sleep... much). We’ve got some juicy updates and plans to share with you. So buckle up your space boots, grab your favorite hoe, and let’s see what’s been growing!

[h1]What Have We Done?! 😲[/h1]
A lot, actually. Like, a [b]lot[/b]. Here's a (very official and important) list of what we've been up to:

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
We hired a fantastic Art Lead who is currently transforming the game’s look into something truly special! Picture this: a mashup of Eastern European sci-fi architecture and Mars. Yes, we’re serious. While most people see "Mars" as cold, desolate, and dry, we’ve infused it with a touch of the familiar – [b]bold, monumental structures that feel like they were built to last ‘for centuries’[/b].

And, of course, we're working on 3D models to match this vision. Soon, you’ll get to see these [b]gorgeous concepts[/b] brought to life in-game. But today, we’re excited to share with you the concept art of:
[list][*] the early concept: [u]greenhouse[/u] with its [u]entrance hall[/u] and ore extractor,
[*] final concept: [u]greenhouse[/u] with its [u]entrance hall[/u],
[*] as well as what the interior might look like,
[*] environmental element. [/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/0a71eca051fa7c1542c23c9229316020144ab437.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/29b93253d08e26e97ee0fe819d7262356344b3c2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/fdcb75cc4c58b5205968b2807282d216deac7f8f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/e05f43638508ccff45689e0d29315137a1db25ac.png[/img]

[h2]Location[/h2]
Ah yes, the little crater. You probably thought that prototype was all we had. Ha! No way. The final version will be a [b]living, breathing map.[/b] Well, maybe not literally breathing — air's a bit thin up there, right? Our tiny team is taking every bit of inspiration from [b]NASA’s [i]Curiosity Rover[/i][/b], crafting Mars into a landscape you’ll want to call home. There will be hills, peaks, ravines, and more nooks than your granny's kitchen.

The Level Designer, Art Lead, and Modelers are busy creating the perfect Mars, but one where you can plant crops without your potato freezing solid.

Check out our screenshots of the new work-in-progress location: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/a3620a74346bb463bbe30a396fa08f734ead9179.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948414/f4a970ea661812975378ee7a57e2cca82b9c9d04.png[/img]

[h2]Code[/h2]
The tech demo at Farm Fest gave us great insights into your thoughts about our work and vision. Your feedback was crucial. We've been improving the mechanics, tweaking systems, and making everything smoother. What did we change?

[h3]Hexagonal system[/h3]
We’ve decided to remove the [u]hexagonal system[/u], as it made the electrical system unclear and took away from the game’s visual style. The robots didn’t like it either — too many awkward turns. Now, we’ve introduced a [b]freer movement system[/b] for more fluid gameplay. Trust us, the robots appreciate it.

[h3]Harvesting[/h3]
Farming is at the heart of AGRONOM, but to make that possible on Mars, we’ve had to think beyond just crops. That’s where the new Ice Extraction mechanic comes in.
[list][*] [b]Ice Extraction.[/b][/list] You can now extract ice yourself! No more "magically appearing water". Ice will be collected similarly to iron, then melted into water.
You’ll now have a new item — [b]water[/b] — that you can carry in your robot farmer or have the helper robots transport. This water can be used in crafting machines and environmental controller.

[b]Harvesting Changes[/b]
[list][*] The [b]greenhouse environment controller[/b] is now more nuanced. The global controller allows only for temperature adjustments. Locally, you can set [u]humidity and light levels[/u] at individual garden beds.
[*] Manual watering (we know, we know — a classic farming game move). Now watering becomes more meaningful. Water for irrigation is not taken from the greenhouse stock, but from your inventory. You literally stand and water your little plant with a watering can. Robotic assistants can also help with watering. Think of them as your loyal minions. But don't forget to charge their batteries. Robots shouldn't starve!
[*] Additional changes include:
The incubator is no longer multi-tiered. It’s now smaller and more practical for your robot helpers.
Several other tweaks have made planting and harvesting simpler and more intuitive. [/list]
[h3]Power System Update:[/h3]
We’ve reworked the power grid to make it more intuitive. Now, [b]power poles[/b] and [b]wires[/b] connect energy sources. Wires run overhead, making it easier to manage complex terrain. Don’t worry, though, planning your power grid is straightforward:
[olist]
[*] Connect one end of the wire to the energy generator (like a windmill),
[*] Connect the other end to the consumer (like a drill).
[*] And voilà! You’re ready to roll. [i]Feel free to plant a birch tree along the way for good measure![/i] [/olist]
[h3]Robot Automation = Robotization[/h3]
One of AGRONOM’s coolest features is our automation system. Whether it’s building structures, mining ore, or even watering plants, our robots have you covered. We’ve worked hard on this, so you don’t have to. Although, we do recommend pet them once in a while. They’re starting to ask for raises.

And now, a little about your trusty assistants! Over the summer, we made progress on developing four types of robots. Each robot has its own specialty, but they can cover for each other if needed. AGRONOM makes your farming life truly easier!
[list][*] [b]Robot Assistant[/b] — your right hand in everything.
[*] [b]Robot Builder[/b] — the construction expert.
[*] [b]Robot Loader[/b] — the one who carries, loads, and delivers.
[*] [b]Robot Worker[/b] — the hardest worker of the bunch.[/list]
[h2]Story[/h2]
This summer, we also worked on developing the game’s story. We’re gathering ideas, solidifying our core pillars, and making sure it fits the cozy vibe of AGRONOM. While AGRONOM won’t be just a sandbox game, expect a [i]relaxing, slow-paced[/i] story that will unfold gradually.

You play as a Robot that was assembled by Uncle Makar — a retired scientist. You are a Robot colonist, a Robot farmer, and a Robot foreman... You will have to raise Uncle Makar's plot from scratch and build him a dacha (weekend house) for a nice and cosy holiday. 

In the game you will not only communicate with your robot assistants, but also interact with your neighbours on Mars. And by exploring the map, you can learn about the true motivation of Uncle Makar to build a dacha on Mars.

[h2]Social Media[/h2]
While we’ve been a bit quiet here, we’ve been active on other platforms like [b]X, TikTok[/b], and our [b]Discord server[/b]. Here’s what you can expect:
[list][*] On [i][url=https://x.com/AGRONOM_GAME]X[/url][/i], we share minor updates, screenshots, and plans for the game.
[*] On [i][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@agronom_game/]TikTok[/url][/i], we’re making memes (and people seem to love them!). If you enjoy memes featuring our characters, follow us!
[*] On [i][url=https://discord.gg/P9dzU3sw5W]Discord[/url][/i], we’re always open for chats with fans, answering questions, and giving you sneak peeks. Join us![/list]
[h1]Coming Soon 😏[/h1]
Our big, heavy, and possibly most important milestone is coming to an end. During this phase, we’ve been finalizing all the core mechanics and polishing the visual style. And the most exciting part? This milestone will lead to the release of our [b]trailer[/b]! It’s coming very soon, and we hope you’re as excited for it as we are.

The AGRONOM team has several tasks ahead that will bring us closer to that next big step:
[list]
[*] Refining and optimizing key systems like construction, quests, trading, and other gameplay mechanics.
[*] Beginning full production of the final 3D assets, including locations, buildings, and characters.
[*] Further expanding the game’s content and levels.
[*] Developing the story and questlines. [/list]
And of course, we’ll stay close to you, sharing our progress, successes, and sometimes even our struggles. We hope you’ll stick with us on this journey — and maybe even invite some friends along too!

Stay cozy, stay curious on Mars! 🚜✨

To support us, please Wishlist piece of our hearts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893250/AGRONOM/
with love,
AGRONOM's team 🧡
